name: What is a Junior ADU (JADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Junior ADU (JADU) is a specific type of accessory dwelling unit that is always located within an existing or proposed single-family dwelling. Unlike a standard ADU, a JADU must be no more than 500 square feet in size and includes an efficiency kitchen, which typically means a sink, cooking appliance, and a small refrigerator. A JADU also does not require additional parking beyond what the main home already has. They offer a flexible housing option, often for family members or as a rental unit, while making efficient use of existing residential space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A Junior ADU (JADU) is an independent living unit up to 500 square feet, located within an existing single-family home, featuring an efficiency kitchen.
